bio:
I am currently a senior (4th-year) undergraduate student with a strong passion for scientific research, deeply dedicated to exploring the world of Generative AI and Video Reasoning.

At present, I am working as a Research Assistant at SELAB (Software Engineering Laboratory), which belongs to the University of Science, Vietnam National University – Ho Chi Minh City (VNU-HCM).

I am fortunate to be conducting research under the guidance and mentorship of PhD(c). Trong-Thuan Nguyen and Assoc. Prof. Minh-Triet Tran, whose expertise and support have played a significant role in shaping my research mindset and academic direction.

Below is an overview of my research journey so far.
